main_text.l: IN THE POINTS QUESTIONED, IS TRULY DELIVERED, AND THE NOVELTY
OF THE NOW ROMISH DOCTRINE PLAINLY DISCOVERED.
From the beginning it was not so.
PRINTED FOR THE SOCIETY OF STATIONERS.

page.notes: The number 1764943 printed at the head is a library stamp, not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
